name: Facet
text: Choose a dark theme by default with a one-click toggle to light mode. It reduces eye strain in low-light settings and keeps the interface sleek, matching the competitive analysis examples. The trade-off is that some users may prefer a light theme for readability in bright environments, but this is easily solved with the toggle.

name: Pane
text: Dark themes hide errors and muted colors—users miss critical data if they assume visibility is fine. A one-click toggle still fails when users don’t know the mode exists or when glare makes the screen unreadable. The real alternative: test both themes with real users in their actual environments—measure task completion time and error rates. That settles it.
